evidence.observation: O2 ~1.7 ppm at start of growth, consistent with the purged baseline during ramp (0-4 ppm)
O2 rose steadily 6.5→8.4→12.2→18.7→20.7→25.3 ppm through the growth hold
Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm setpoint, so the rise is not from low purge flow or a stuck MFC
T holds 750±0.5 °C with stable heater power ~44%, so the thermocouple and heater look normal

args.missing_evidence: No pressure gauge is installed, so I can't use pressure to rule out an exhaust blockage. A leak check (isolate the tube or spray Ar/He on the seals) or a step change in Ar flow while watching O2 would tell a leak apart from a blockage. No characterization of the sample exists yet.
